mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO operation_task_step ( task_no, step_no, executor_id, operation_type, step_status, request_params, result_json, error_code, failure_reason, dispatch_time, start_time, end_time, created_time, updated_time ) VALUES
( #{step.taskNo}, #{step.stepNo}, #{step.executorId}, #{step.operationType}, #{step.stepStatus}, CAST(#{step.requestParams} AS JSONB), CAST(#{step.resultJson} AS JSONB), #{step.errorCode}, #{step.failureReason}, #{step.dispatchTime}, #{step.startTime}, #{step.endTime}, #{step.createdTime}, #{step.updatedTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE operation_task_step SET step_status = #{step.stepStatus}, result_json = CAST(#{step.resultJson} AS JSONB), error_code = #{step.errorCode}, failure_reason = #{step.failureReason}, start_time = #{step.startTime}, end_time = #{step.endTime}, updated_time = #{step.updatedTime} WHERE id = #{step.id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_no, step_no, executor_id, operation_type, step_status, request_params, result_json, error_code, failure_reason, dispatch_time, start_time, end_time, created_time, updated_time FROM operation_task_step WHERE task_no = #{taskNo} AND step_no = #{stepNo} ORDER BY id ASC
